page.content:
Dictator of Nazi Germany who launched the European war.

How Adolf Hitler connects

  • Faction: Nazi Germany — Hitler dictated Nazi Germany.
  • Event: Operation Barbarossa — Hitler ordered the invasion of the Soviet Union.
  • Event: Holocaust — Hitler's regime conceived and ordered the genocide.

What is Adolf Hitler?

Adolf Hitler headed the Nazi Party and the German state from 1933. He ordered the invasions that began the European war and the genocide that is the Holocaust, and he died in Berlin in 1945.

Key threads lead to Nazi Germany, Operation Barbarossa and Holocaust.
